explication: any-llm is a Python SDK that presents a unified, typed interface to many LLM providers. A developer can call the direct API functions or create a reusable AnyLLM instance, select a provider and model, and receive normalized results; provider adapters handle provider-specific interaction. The README also documents streaming, tools, Responses API, model listing, and structured outputs. Provider dispatch and adapter relationships are supported by the README and registry documentation; detailed internals of unsampled modules are not inferred.
